claim: Official feature list creates a BIP39 phrase from D6 dice. Stateless signing requires the original seed and any passphrase; no live device tested. Photo-entropy BIP39 generation is a separate listed feature from dice entropy and from existing SeedQR input. SeedQR storage/input is a transport for an existing seed, not evidence of generation. Feature list includes indexed BIP85 child phrases. Parent seed, index and parameters matter; it is not interchangeable with direct entropy generation.
